items.title: W.T. "Ed" Kirkeby Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: When I took over Fats in 1938, that was the job of the lifetime.

ctx.x: New Orleans Jazz Band, were mainly commercial titles. So they tried to sell the big band on dance work and commercial titles and songs. Current titles, current songs. Yes, and the small band played the original repertoire. Yeah. You don't recall anybody in the big band?

No, I do not. No, I do not. We had so many bands that day that personnel didn't enter in. It was a matter of getting jobs. We were concerned with. When I took over Fats in 1938, that was the job of the lifetime. Because if ever there was a hunk of talent weighing 285 pounds, who was a genius without doubt, but who at the same time loved to have a good time, like any other mother's favorite son, I'm telling you that I spent six years of glorious listening and a great deal of mental turpitude and harassment until…
